author: IGN
description: Don't miss the early access release date trailer for Humanica, a city-builder game developed by PanfachDev. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills in this game about an ancient settlement. Arm your settlers and build walls with towers to defend your settlement from evil wild animals and hordes of nomads. Humanica is launching on March 3 for PC (Steam) in Early Access.

description:
The Nioh games were already known for offering tons of weapons choices, plus a variety of stances to change up the pace of combat. Thanks to a new Ninja form, Nioh 3 outright doubles the number of weapon choices. That makes 14 total weapons you can wield, which can be a tough choice. This video will break down how each one functions, plus name a few core stats and skills to really showcase what it can do.

#IGN #gaming

author: IGN
description:
Cyberpunk 2077’s launch in 2020 was one of the most infamous moments in gaming history, but the Night City of today is unrecognizable compared to the one we first visited. From the foundational fixes of the early patches to the massive 2.0 gameplay overhaul and the spy-thriller expansion Phantom Liberty, CD Projekt Red has spent years rebuilding the RPG they originally promised. Whether you’re a returning merc or a first-time visitor on the new Nintendo Switch 2, we’re breaking down every major system change, new feature, and technical upgrade that fueled one of the greatest redemption arcs in gaming.

In this comprehensive Cyberpunk 2077 retrospective, we track the evolution of the game through Patch 1.5’s next-gen debut, the Edgerunners update, and the game-changing Update 2.0 and 2.1 features like the NCART metro and vehicle combat. We also take a look at the most recent 2024 and 2025 updates, including Update 2.3’s AutoDrive system, Mac support, and how the game performs on the Ni
title: Cyberpunk 2077: Everything Major Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description:
Join the Arctic Hazard development team for a behind-the-scenes look at Norse: Oath of Blood in this latest video for the upcoming Viking-era turn-based tactical game set in Dark Age Norway. The new Norse: Oath of Blood development video takes a look at creating the historically grounded world, including motion-capture performances, maps, and more. Norse: Oath of Blood will be available on PC (Steam, GOG, and Epic Games Store) on February 17, 2026. It will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S in spring 2026.

In Norse: Oath of Blood, embark on an epic quest for vengeance as Gunnar, a young warrior whose destiny is forged in blood and betrayal. After the treacherous Steinarr Far-Spear murders his father, Jarl Gripr, and usurps his high seat, Gunnar's path is clear: rebuild, ally, and rise to reclaim honor and justice.

#IGN #gaming
title: Norse: Oath of Blood - Official Developer Diary #2: World Building Video

author: IGN
description:
It was recently revealed that a live-action adaptation of Larian’s award-winning RPG, Baldur’s Gate 3, is on the way from prestige TV makers HBO. It somewhat makes sense at first glance — you can see the Game of Thrones of it all weaving into Baldur’s Gate’s DNA, which itself isn’t shy of a fair helping of shedding both blood and clothes. But look a little closer, and the worries begin. Not necessarily when considering Craig Mazin’s involvement (we’ll get to that later) but when noticing that, apparently, Larian, Baldur's Gate 3's developers, will play no significant role in the show’s development. A decision I can’t help but feel would be a big mistake.

#IGN #gaming
title: HBO's Baldur’s Gate 3 Without Larian Would Be a Big Mistake

author: IGN
description: Larian Studios’ multi-award-winning fantasy RPG, Baldur’s Gate 3, is set for its own TV series on HBO, and will be helmed by The Last of Us co-creator Craig Mazin. Max Scoville has all the details on your Daily Fix!
title: Baldur's Gate 3's Story Will Continue... On HBO - IGN Daily Fix
